description: Returns a public page or PDF as Markdown, in chunks, with a paid upgrade link. Use when an agent needs one URL's readable text. Not for JavaScript-only pages or crawling whole sites; use the linked paid tool for those. Default chunk is 20,000 characters; start_index reads later chunks within the free 100,000-character window. Apify Actor links can be paid with x402 via Apify, no Apify account needed.
name: read_url
